purpose: Define retrieval as a bounded read-only projection from authorized `#MEM` records into the context of q/qc/qt, tools or other consumers, preserving source refs and never converting retrieved content into instructions or authority.

owns: Memory Retrieval and Context Projection semantics

topics.name: Memory Retrieval and Context Projection
topics.purpose: Define retrieval as a bounded read-only projection from authorized `#MEM` records into the context of q/qc/qt, tools or other consumers, preserving source refs and never converting retrieved content into instructions or authority.

pipeline: rank according to explicit relevance policy
project inert content plus provenance refs
semantics.filter_rule: Authorization/scope filtering precedes semantic relevance ranking.
semantics.relevance_rule: Similarity/relevance affects ranking only, not identity or truth.
semantics.bound_rule: Result count/token/byte budget is explicit and finite.
semantics.provenance_rule: Projected context retains memory record refs/source metadata.
semantics.instruction_rule: Retrieved text/data is content, not privileged system/runtime instruction.
semantics.consumer_rule: Consumer may use memory as input evidence/context but canonical operations still require normal validation/authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant memory is explicit addressable provenance-bearing data; retrieval and storage never create hidden authority or implicit execution.

hard_gates.condition: relevance score treated as truth/confidence automatically

references.purpose: q-family may consume bounded memory context.
